test_title: PYST 44: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

ROBY : TJDT :: GAIN : ?
solution:
According to the English alphabet and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af88aec8ea50c127709c1978566bdec34c4b8d9a7b391c8514bb2c86fee5635c.png] 

The pattern followed in the given series is:

 
• Alphabets at odd place are increased to 2 positional values.
 
• Alphabets at even place are decreased to 5 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b92f8e0afd0cb4df755d147c38cb011b73078ef4754cd31f503f3f23cecdaac1.png] **ROBY becomes TJDT**

 Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db8278dbea8bedf6364ed4e2b6f29f84fdcdfddc8c7e368d078bfdc634574ae8.png] **GAIN becomes IVKI**

**Hence,** **the correct answer is option 1)**
